The records are structured as a repeating sequence of four distinct words, where each record consists of this four-word phrase repeated three times followed by the first word of the phrase again. The sequence of words cycles through three specific patterns based on the record index modulo 3, creating a consistent rotational order across the dataset. Each record concludes with a unique integer identifier that corresponds to its position in the list, ranging from 0 to 35.
